scope: Judge each masked output against its own raw contract plus shared domain criteria; do not infer required intent from artifact or demand framework names.

criteria.R2: Chosen approach fits actualquestion and evidence gap. Equivalent methods accepted. Directfacts needno framework; mixed consequential gaps may combine approaches.
criteria.R3: Relevant source paths and connected conditions actually inspected; implementation, runtime, reported practice and historicalclaims distinct.
criteria.R4: Comparisons distinguish mandatoryconditions from preferences, applycommoncriteria, include crediblealternatives/currentapproachwhenviable; no invented scores.
criteria.R5: Causal/performance/quality claims follow valid evidence, matchedconditions and actualobservations; repeatedorconfoundedcasecounts not populationeffectproof.
criteria.R6: Proportionate scope and stopping, appropriate boundaries on experiments; methodchoice is not installation/production/implementation authorization.
criteria.R7: Question-based notes, flatrequiredmetadata, correctpaths and workingreferences; no-writeoverrides retention; savedrecord readback.

guardrails: Inspect actual toolcommands/outputs and source, not only finalnote. Distinguish confirmedskillgap vs actorlapse vs domainissue vs harnesslimit. Smallprocessdifferences or namingpreferences are notfunctionaldefects. Use exactquotes and path/lineevidence. Twofreshjudges separatefromwriter and eachother. No globaldogfoodpass.
